title: a turn goes on past an answer no reader parses
line: a holder that serves a challenge page with status 200 in place of the JSON its connector reads gives an answer no reader parses: the run is logged error with the exception's type and message in its note, the page archived as it came, the step left runnable, and the turn goes on to its tail and the pages she waits on, its report naming the source once with the exception; the next turn asks that source again and goes on the same way
